title: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-2 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ikhlas, Al-Masad and joining letters
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-2 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 13. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ (١) ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ (٢)

keywords.def: sincerity: the name of the surah

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ikhlas 112:1-2 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 112:1-2 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Hold up one finger and say: 'Allah is One'.
questions.a: Pupil says it with one finger up.
A) One. أَحَدٌ means One: Allah is One.

questions.q: Think again: If someone asked you 'Who is Allah?', what would you say?
questions.a: Allah is One (112:1); everyone needs Him and He needs no one (112:2).
